name: Tita Flawless Brandt
original_name: ティータ・Ｆ（フローレス）・ブラント
source:
Tita “Flawless” Brandt lives right next to the Tomoe household and is the tsundere ojousama. Disregarding Shizuma, she is a good friend to everyone in the Tomoe household. She is in constant competition with both [url=/c1504]Yukina[/url] and [url=/c1503]Makina[/url] in sports and academics, but she usually ends up trailing behind. Nevertheless, Tita has spunk and is not afraid to speak out her mind. And despite her initial impression of Shizuma as a pervert, with lots of time she will also see his good qualities.

[Edited from [url=http://verbalrubbish.oniichannoecchi.com/?p=374]m3rryweather's review[/url].]
